JWT_SECRET.description: JWT signing key for dashboard session tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

API_KEY_SECRET.description: Encryption key for API keys stored in the database. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin login password. Change this after first login via Dashboard → Settings → Security

BASE_URL.description: Canonical server-side public URL of this deployment. Without it the app falls back to http://localhost:20128, which breaks OAuth callback and cloud-sync links in the dashboard.

NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Browser-facing public URL, baked into the client bundle. Must match BASE_URL.

HOSTNAME.description: Bind address. Must be 0.0.0.0 for Railway to route traffic to the service.

AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Set the Secure flag on session cookies. Upstream defaults to false, which sends session cookies without the Secure attribute.

DATA_DIR.description: Data directory for SQLite database and storage (must match volume mount)

PORT.description: Port for Dashboard UI and API (single-port mode)

OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB.description: Node.js heap size in MB. Leave empty for automatic sizing from the container memory limit.
